projectPhase.title: Project Phase
projectPhase.summary: A named phase within a project with its own status, billable flag and budget; phase status changes are dispatched to the Shillinq ledger in the parent project's context.
projectPhase.description: Phases break a project into delivery stages (e.g. discovery, build, hypercare). A phase carries its own status, optional description, optional explicit billable flag (otherwise inherited from the parent project) and an optional phase-level budgetHours. When status changes the ledger integration fetches the parent project and dispatches a status-changed event in the project's context rather than per phase.

sequence.description: Ordering of the phase within the project (also exposed as 'order' in the UI).
sequence.title: Sequence

billable.description: Explicit billable flag for this phase. When null/unset the resolved value is inherited from the parent project (REQ-PTH-005).
billable.title: Billable

projectTask.title: Project Task
projectTask.summary: A deliverable within a phase — the third level of the WBS.
projectTask.description: A project task is a discrete deliverable inside a project phase. It carries an estimated effort in hours, an optional assignee (Nextcloud user UID), an explicit billable override that overrides the phase / project resolved billable value, and a deadline. The denormalised project reference enables efficient project-scoped queries without a phase join. Mapped to schema:Action.

phase.description: UUID reference to the parent projectPhase.
phase.title: Phase

project.description: Denormalised UUID reference to the project (set on save) for faster project-scoped queries.
project.title: Project

sequence.description: Ordering of the task within its phase (also exposed as 'order' in the UI).
sequence.title: Sequence

billable.description: Explicit billable flag for this task. When null/unset the resolved value is inherited from the parent phase (REQ-PTH-005).
billable.title: Billable

estimatedHours.description: Planned effort for this task in hours.
estimatedHours.title: Estimated Hours

assignee.description: Nextcloud user UID assigned to the task (schema:agent).
assignee.title: Assignee

projectActivity.title: Project Activity
projectActivity.summary: A time entry recorded against a project task — the fourth (leaf) level of the WBS.
projectActivity.description: A project activity is one user time entry against a projectTask. It is finer-grained than the project-level timeEntry schema (which is the approval/WIP-sync record dispatched to Shillinq): activities are the day-to-day capture surface inside the WBS tree. Each activity stores the date the work was performed, a duration in minutes, the executing user, and an optional billable override that wins over the resolved task/phase/project billable chain (REQ-PTH-005). The denormalised project reference enables project activity-list / budget roll-ups without a join. Mapped to schema:Action with schema:duration.

task.description: UUID reference to the parent projectTask.
task.title: Task

project.description: Denormalised UUID reference to the project (set on save).
project.title: Project

description.description: Free-text description of the work performed.
description.title: Description

date.description: ISO 8601 date the work was performed.
date.title: Date

billable.description: Explicit billable flag for this activity. When null/unset the resolved value is inherited from the parent task (REQ-PTH-005).
billable.title: Billable

user.description: Nextcloud user UID who performed the work.
user.title: User

hourlyRate.description: Optional rate override in EUR/hour. When null/unset the project's hourlyRate is used.
hourlyRate.title: Hourly Rate
